name: Oberhofen am Thunersee (Switzerland)
description: Square banner of the arms of Oberhofen am Thunersee: divided vertically red and white, over all a vine on a yellow stake rising from a green three-peaked mount, with white grapes on the red and red grapes on the white.
history: Swiss municipal flags are square banners of the municipal arms, used alongside the arms without a separate adoption act.

features.role: vine on a stake with grapes counterchanged
